reason: Primary purpose is conversational UI navigation for DSH web: the plugin adds a right-side question rail to long chats so users can jump directly to specific user-question turns, based on DOM-extracted question items and in-page scroll position tracking.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 网页对话的导航插件，在右侧显示可交互的用户问题入口，支持点击跳转到对应对话轮次并随滚动高亮当前位置。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a right-edge navigation rail for DSH web conversations, showing user-question shortcuts you can click to jump to a specific turn while highlighting your current position as you scroll.

capabilities: Injects a right-edge in-page navigation rail into the DSH web conversation interface
Reads user question flow nodes from conversation DOM state and builds jump markers
Enables click-to-scroll navigation to specific conversation turns via element references
Tracks scroll position and highlights the currently active question marker
Uses DOM observers/timers to refresh marker rendering as conversation content changes

reasons.code: The plugin is described as adding a slim right-edge question-navigation rail that shows hoverable ticks per user question and enables jump-to-turn behavior in long DSH conversations.

The feature list explains extraction from DOM attributes (`data-chat-flow-kind="user"`) and direct element-based `scrollIntoView` jumping, plus MutationObserver-based resync and scroll-based highlighting.
Repository description and package metadata indicate the plugin is a DSH web plugin (client-side platform), so behavior is page-local and UI-oriented rather than server-side.
